title: Page chats
description: Talk to people who message CoreUp's own Facebook Page / Instagram: reply in time, send the sample shop, then offer a trial shop.

window.freeHint: Within 24 h of the customer's last message: send normally
window.humanHint: After 24 h, up to 7 days: only when a person presses send (HUMAN_AGENT). Never for promotions.
window.closedHint: More than 7 days: nothing can be sent until the customer writes again

list.emptyAll: No chats yet: they appear when someone messages the Page or you press "Sync last 30 days"

conversation.pick: Pick a chat on the left to reply
conversation.aiPaused: Automatic reply is paused (the team answered)

composer.closedNote: More than 7 days: nothing can be sent until the customer writes again
composer.issuesTitle: This message may contain wrong facts
composer.confirmTitle: This message has wrong facts. Send anyway?
composer.confirmBody: The customer would see information that does not match the real system. Please fix it first.

suggestion.title: AI closing assistant
suggestion.needsPerson: A person should answer this one (discount, phone number or a customer ready to sign up). Automation will not send it.

followUp.title: Follow up today · day {{day}}
followUp.free: Still inside the free 24 h window (can be automatic in settings)
followUp.human: Needs a person to press send

setup.title: Connect CoreUp's Page to this inbox
setup.body: Press once: the system subscribes to the Page's messages (and the linked Instagram) and reads the last 30 days. It never messages anyone by itself.
setup.ownerOnly: Ask the owner to connect the Page first
setup.tokenMissing: META_SYSTEM_USER_TOKEN is not set on the server (Railway): the connect button cannot work yet
setup.webhookMissing: META_APP_SECRET / IG_WEBHOOK_VERIFY_TOKEN are not set: new messages cannot arrive yet (the 30-day read still works)

settings.title: Page inbox settings
settings.noInstagram: No Instagram account is linked to this Page
settings.webhookUrl: Webhook callback URL (paste in the Meta App Dashboard)
settings.autoReplyHint: Always OFF first. When on: answers a customer's NEW message by itself, only inside 24 h, stops the moment the team replies, never answers discounts, phone numbers or people ready to sign up.
settings.maxPerDay: Automatic replies per chat per day (max)
settings.autoFollowUpHint: Always OFF first. Sends the day-1 reminder by itself only while the 24 h window is open. Day 3 and day 6 always need a person to press send.
settings.ownerOnly: Only the owner can change the settings

errors.window_closed: Meta no longer allows a message (24 h or 7 days passed). Nothing can be sent until the customer writes again.
errors.no_customer_message: This chat has no customer message yet, so nothing can be sent
errors.not_connected: Connect the Page before turning this on
errors.meta_unauthorized: The Meta token expired or cannot send. Ask the owner to check it.
errors.meta_unavailable: Meta is slow or down for a moment. Try again.
errors.already_linked: This chat is already linked to another shop
errors.generic: Could not complete that. Try again.
